findings.evidence: TR-9, US4.5: the migrate command never names its failure code. src/Iskender.ControlPlane.Host/Program.cs drops MigrationOutcome.Code, event 7006 has no code field, and no other event names persistence.unavailable or persistence.migration_locked (T039, T046 results). Gap type partial. T049.

FR-012, TR-10, TR-14: a configuration that module settings reject at host start (CoordinationSettings redis username/password outside development, leases.maximumDuration; PostgreSqlSettings poolMinimum above poolMaximum) escapes app.StartAsync in src/Iskender.Infrastructure.Container/ContainerEntryPoint.cs as exit 1 with 7005 naming GatewayException and no code, where equal ports exits 2 with 7002 (T034 note). Gap type partial. T050.

Container contract Telemetry rule 2, FR-028: the other standard OTEL_* variables do not configure the OTLP exporter, because CreateEmptyBuilder leaves the SDK IConfiguration empty and ContainerTelemetry passes only the endpoint (T028 open note). Gap type partial. T051.

Container contract Migration command rule 5, Diagnostics rules 4 and 6: ContainerEntryPoint.RunAsync awaits a definition command with no catch, and MigrationCommand rethrows any non-persistence failure, so such a migrate run writes no 7006 and ends with the runtime unhandled-exception trace, message included, on standard error. Gap type partial. T052.

SC-001, tasks note No fixed sleeps (a real flake is a blocker): the intermittent CoordinationReasonTests authentication_failed failure recorded in T025 is still open and its cause unknown. Gap type partial. T053. Pass 2: T053 was closed by the maintainer's decision with the cause not found; the 2026-11-16 pass-2 gate passed 5270/5270 with no recurrence. CONV-0007-008 names a concrete candidate cause (readiness answers 500 with no content type when EvaluateAsync throws); T056 fixes it and records whether the symptom recurs.

tasks note Container validation: HealthAsync in src/Iskender.Infrastructure.Container/ContainerEntryPoint.cs builds its ServiceCollection with BuildServiceProvider() and no ValidateScopes or ValidateOnBuild. Gap type partial. T054.

FR-017, TR-8, SC-005, data-model Lifecycle ("start: listeners bound, lifecycle starting"): WebApplicationBuilder adds GenericWebHostService after the application's services, so CompositionLifecycle.StartAsync (src/Iskender.Domain composition, CompositionLifecycle.cs:104-119) finishes the guard start and capability check before Kestrel binds; liveness cannot answer and starting/stopping-during-start-up are never visible over HTTP. research.md R5 states the reverse order. StopDuringStartupTests.cs:59-66 checks stopping only in process. Gap type contradicts. T055.

FR-016, FR-018, container contract Readiness rule 1: HealthEndpoints.cs:41 sets ContentType only after EvaluateAsync returns; Probes() (ReadinessEvaluator.cs:159-170), the single-instance read (:64), and Capability() (catches only GatewayException, :130) can throw, giving a Kestrel 500 with no content type or body. Gap type partial. T056.

FR-025, TR-14: src/Iskender.ControlPlane.Host/Program.cs:44-67 holds the migrate outcome default, exception mapping, and the 7006 write; only image tests reach it, and they reach failure paths only, so 7006 with outcome succeeded and a count, and 7006 on exit 1, are never verified. Gap type partial. T057.
FR-028: no test touches the MeterProvider; AddMeter at ContainerTelemetry.cs:62 is unverified. Gap type partial. T058.

SC-006: migrate output in MigrationImageTests is checked only against Scenarios.DocumentValues, not the four canaries. Gap type partial. T060.
FR-019: ProbeGate.cs:71 stamps _lastAt after the probe returns, so a slow probe's result can be reused past readinessCacheDuration. Gap type partial. T061.

SC-003, US3/AC3: LivenessProbeCountTests.cs checks 0 probe calls only for a healthy control plane. Gap type partial. T063.
